verdict: OBSTRUCTION: LRS mechanism on E*(z,rho/2) yields only beta <= 7/4; Rankin-Selberg pole at 2-beta moves with the parameter (P - beta_0 = 1 in every rank); E_a / EIS-w pass every step
claim: Stage A only; nothing about zeros of zeta. At xi(rho)=0 the completed Rankin-Selberg function of E*(z,rho/2) has one simple pole pair (six residues carry xi(rho)), as for a cusp form, but at P=2-beta; the gamma pole read by Luo-Rudnick-Sarnak is at 1-beta, so P-beta_0=1 always. The forced vanishing is the trivial zero L(0,chi)=0 for even chi, an identity for every parameter. The mechanism's inequality is beta<=7/4. Pivot to Borel Eisenstein objects of any rank closed: the dominant constant-term exponent never vanishes.
obstructionKind: pole position tied to parameter (no square-integrability); forced vanishing is a trivial zero; generic-parameter Eisenstein passes
lesson: Cuspidality enters LRS three times: entire twists, a single pole, and the pole's position P=1. A zero supplies the single pole but not its position; for Eisenstein data the pole sits at 1 + parameter in every rank.
followUp: Independent referee owed. Open cell: a Hecke eigen-object with parameter rho whose Rankin-Selberg pole lies strictly left of 2-beta (non-Borel data); none on file.
